description: This file defines the RequestResponseNamedArgs class, which implements an invocation strategy for Slim Framework routes. It allows route callbacks to be called with request, response, and route parameters as individual arguments.

classes.name: RequestResponseNamedArgs
classes.description: An invocation strategy that calls route callables with request, response, and route arguments as separate parameters.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the given callable with request, response, and route arguments as individual parameters and returns the response.
